Welcome to Pixelated episode 127. This week, we're unlocking a bonus episode from the vault. Originally recorded in the aftermath of the Pixel 11 launch and review cycle, listen in as Abner, Damien, and Will discuss how they stay motivated to continue reporting on and reviewing technology products, the state of criticism on the internet in 2026, and the joys of just appreciating what you like regardless of other people's opinions.
